items.name: Speed Cubing Mumbai Unlimited 2015

venue.name: Infiniti Mall, Malad
venue.address: Near Goregaon Sports Complex, Off Link Road, Malad West, Mumbai - 400 064

items.information: First visit our website to pay registration fees & then select the events you wish to participate in from here.  Registration will be canceled if fees are not paid.  On-site registration is available on 15th & 16th Jan. The on-site registration fees & schedule will be available on the SCMU website. Participants must collect their ID cards at the venue before the competition. Please see the SCMU website for details.
